title: MZ [Free Plugin] CT_NoteTagEditor — Visual Notetag Editor for RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: CynthiaTools
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I recently launched
CT_NoteTagEditor
, a free developer tool/plugin for
RPG Maker MZ
.
This tool is made for editing database notetags visually inside the game runtime through
CT_DevModeManager
, instead of constantly jumping back and forth through the RPG Maker database editor.
It supports notetag editing for:
Actors
Classes
Skills
Items
Weapons
Armors
Enemies
States
Tilesets
Main features include:
Visual notetag editor
Searchable database object list
Quick notetag insert helpers
Runtime apply
Permanent JSON save in local playtest / NW.js mode
Automatic backup before saving
Batch append / prepend / replace / remove tools
Responsive UI support for 1920×1080, 1280×720, and 816×624
This is not a player-facing menu plugin. It is mainly a development/editor tool for people who work with plugin notetags often.
It requires
CT_DevModeManager
and should be opened from:
Dev Dashboard → Dev Tools → [4] NoteTag Editor
You can check it out here:
https://cynthiatool.itch.io/4ct-notetageditor-visual-notetag-editor-for-rpg-maker-mz
Feedback is welcome, especially from users working on larger RPG Maker MZ projects with many database entries or heavy notetag usage.
Thank you!
